title: Savory Chicken Tikka Skewers
description: Tender and flavorful chicken skewers cooked in a blend of Indian spices, served as a delicious snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together savory, chili powder, garam masala, and lemon juice.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and garnish with chopped cilantro and onions.
Serve hot with naan or rice.
